name: CSAE
goal: Operate a public UAE car-event calendar where approved Telegram submissions are validated, committed through GitHub, and published automatically on GitHub Pages.
features: External Git-tracked event feed in data/events.json
Duplicate and schema validation before publication
GitHub Contents API commits with optimistic concurrency
Automatic GitHub Pages publication from main
GRC task, timeline, resume, and handoff coordination
status: active — site live; Telegram activation waiting for credentials

flow.title: Telegram intake
flow.desc: A permitted operator sends an Instagram link and labeled event details; publication always requires an explicit approval.

flow.title: GitHub publication
flow.desc: Approved events are validated and committed to the repository; GitHub Pages rebuilds the public calendar from main.

items.text: GitHub Contents API update with SHA concurrency

flow.title: GRC coordination
flow.desc: GRC keeps the project state portable across Hermes, local models, and future agents.

flow_note: The operating loop is Telegram submission → human approval → validated GitHub commit → automatic GitHub Pages refresh. GRC records the work, blockers, and exact next action so any connected agent can resume safely.

sections.title: System connections
sections.short: Telegram supplies events, GitHub stores and publishes them, and GRC coordinates the work.
sections.html:
• Live site: pusliqour.github.io/car-society-uae
  • Repository: github.com/pusliqour/car-society-uae
  • Event source: data/events.json
  • Bot entry point: scripts/run_bot.sh
  • Only blocker: BotFather token plus confirmed Telegram chat ID.
